definition_zh: 爆炸性的；易爆的；激增的；炸药
definition_en: able to explode; likely to cause a violent reaction; growing very fast; a substance that explodes
core_image: 一包被引线点燃、即将炸开的火药
scene: 警方拆除了一枚爆炸装置。Police defused an explosive device.
sceneCN: 这里 explosive 是「会爆炸的、易爆的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：警方拆除了一枚爆炸装置。

senses.title: Able to explode
senses.definition: able or likely to explode
senses.definitionCN: 能够爆炸或容易爆炸的
senses.example: The workers found an explosive device near the bridge.
senses.exampleCN: 工人们在桥附近发现了一枚爆炸装置。
senses.why: The core sense is the power to burst apart.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是具有炸裂的力量。

senses.title: Likely to erupt
senses.definition: likely to cause a sudden violent reaction or very fast growth
senses.definitionCN: 很可能引发突然的激烈反应或极快增长的
senses.example: The region saw explosive growth in tourism.
senses.exampleCN: 该地区的旅游业出现了爆炸式增长。
senses.why: Physical bursting becomes sudden social change.
senses.whyCN: 物理上的炸开转为社会的骤然变化。

senses.title: An explosive substance
senses.definition: a substance that can explode
senses.definitionCN: 能够爆炸的物质
senses.example: The mine stores explosives in a secure shed.
senses.exampleCN: 矿场把炸药存放在安全的棚屋里。
senses.why: The quality becomes a physical material.
senses.whyCN: 性质变成一种具体的物质。

intro.en: Explosive comes from Latin explodere, to drive off by clapping, through explosion.
intro.cn: explosive 经 explosion 来自拉丁语 explodere，原意为「用拍手声赶走」。

items.en: Ex- means out and plaudere means to clap.
items.cn: ex- 意为向外，plaudere 意为拍手。

items.en: Explodere means to drive an actor off by clapping.
items.cn: explodere 意为用拍手声把演员赶下台。

items.en: Explosion becomes the word for a violent burst.
items.cn: explosion 成为表示猛烈爆裂的名词。

items.en: Explosive describes what can burst.
items.cn: explosive 描述能够爆裂的事物。

items.en: Explosive also describes fast growth and tense situations.
items.cn: 现代英语中 explosive 也可形容快速增长与紧张局势。

note.en: Explosive means able to burst; expensive means costing a lot.
note.cn: explosive 是会爆炸的，expensive 则是昂贵的。

entries.definition: likely to change or break suddenly
able to catch fire and burn

normalIntro.en: Explosive describes materials that burst and situations that may erupt.
normalIntro.cn: explosive 既形容会爆裂的物质，也形容可能爆发的局势。

normal.en: The bomb squad carried the explosive away.
normal.cn: 拆弹小组把爆炸物运走了。

normal.en: The market showed explosive growth last year.
normal.cn: 去年市场出现了爆炸式增长。

normal.en: The debate turned explosive within minutes.
normal.cn: 辩论几分钟内就变得火药味十足。

normal.en: Hydrogen is highly explosive in the wrong conditions.
normal.cn: 在不当条件下，氢气极易爆炸。

normal.en: The report warned of an explosive situation.
normal.cn: 报告警告说局势一触即发。

abstract.en: Picture a spark touching a trail of powder.
abstract.cn: 想象一颗火星碰到火药引线。

abstract.en: Imagine a crowd that suddenly erupts in anger.
abstract.cn: 想象人群突然爆发出愤怒。

abstract.en: Think of a graph line shooting straight up.
abstract.cn: 想象一条几乎垂直上升的曲线。

examples.en: The army cleared the field of explosives.
examples.cn: 军队清除了战场上的爆炸物。

examples.en: Explosive population growth put pressure on housing.
examples.cn: 爆炸式的人口增长给住房带来压力。

examples.en: The chemical is too explosive to store indoors.
examples.cn: 这种化学品太易爆，不能存放在室内。

dict_mnemonic.text: explode（爆炸）加形容词后缀 -ive，就是「会爆炸的」，即 explosive。

root: 源自拉丁语 explodere（用拍手声赶下台），经 explosion（爆裂）形成形容词 explosive，核心义「会爆开的」。

sensesIntro.en: Explosive means able to explode, likely to cause a sudden eruption, or a substance that explodes.
sensesIntro.cn: explosive 意为会爆炸的、可能突然爆发的，或炸药。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a spark reaching a trail of powder.
core.cn: 核心意象：火星触到火药引线。

branches.en: The base sense is the ability to burst.
branches.cn: 基础义是具有爆裂的能力。

branches.en: Bursting becomes sudden growth or anger.
branches.cn: 爆裂转为骤然增长或愤怒。

branches.en: The quality becomes a physical material.
branches.cn: 性质变成具体的物质。

branches.en: A device and a situation can both be explosive.
branches.cn: 装置与局势都可能是爆炸性的。

branches.en: Explosive growth and stored explosives share the idea of force.
branches.cn: 爆炸式增长与储存的炸药都带有力量之意。

intro.en: Explosive belongs to the explode family, built on Latin ex- out and plaudere to clap.
intro.cn: explosive 属于 explode 词族，由拉丁语 ex-（向外）与 plaudere（拍手）构成。

latinIntro.en: Latin explodere and explosio are the source forms of the family.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 explodere 与 explosio 是该词族的来源形式。

items.meaning: able to explode or an explosive substance
items.example: The box held an explosive charge.
The old shell could still explode.
items.exampleCN: 那枚旧炮弹仍可能爆炸。
这种气体可能爆炸性燃烧。

items.example: They measured the explosiveness of the dust.
items.exampleCN: 他们测量了粉尘的爆炸性。

items.example: The team removed the explosives safely.
items.exampleCN: 小组安全移除了爆炸物。

items.example: The exploding shell lit the sky.
items.exampleCN: 爆炸的炮弹照亮了天空。

definition_en: to send goods to another country; to spread ideas or skills abroad; goods sold abroad
core_image: 装满货物的集装箱驶向海外港口
scene: 这家公司向欧洲出口机器。The company exports machines to Europe.
sceneCN: 这里 export 是「出口货物」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这家公司向欧洲出口机器。

senses.title: Sell goods abroad
senses.definition: to send goods to another country for sale
senses.definitionCN: 把货物运往另一国家销售
senses.example: The country exports coffee and bananas.
senses.exampleCN: 这个国家出口咖啡和香蕉。
senses.why: The core sense is carrying goods out.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是把货物运出去。

senses.title: Spread ideas abroad
senses.definition: to spread ideas, skills, or culture to other places
senses.definitionCN: 把思想、技术或文化传播到其他地方
senses.example: The university exports its teaching methods.
senses.exampleCN: 这所大学输出自己的教学方法。
senses.why: Goods are replaced by ideas that travel out.
senses.whyCN: 货物被向外传播的思想所取代。

senses.title: Goods sold abroad
senses.definition: goods or services sold to another country
senses.definitionCN: 卖到另一国家的商品或服务
senses.example: Oil is the country's main export.
senses.exampleCN: 石油是这个国家的主要出口商品。
senses.why: The action becomes the thing being sent.
senses.whyCN: 动作变成被运出的东西。

intro.en: Export comes from Latin exportare, to carry out, from ex- out and portare to carry.
intro.cn: export 来自拉丁语 exportare（运出去），由 ex-（向外）与 portare（搬运）构成。

items.en: Ex- means out.
items.cn: ex- 意为向外。

items.en: Portare means to carry.
items.cn: portare 意为搬运。

items.en: Exportare means to carry out.
items.cn: exportare 意为运出去。

items.en: Export names trade that sends goods away.
items.cn: export 指把货物运往外的贸易。

items.en: Export also covers ideas and services.
items.cn: 现代英语中 export 也涵盖思想与服务。

note.en: Export means send out; import means bring in.
note.cn: export 是运出去，import 则是运进来。

entries.definition: to bring goods into a country
to carry from one place to another

normalIntro.en: Export is about goods and ideas carried out of a country.
normalIntro.cn: export 指货物与思想被运出一个国家。

normal.en: Brazil exports coffee to many countries.
normal.cn: 巴西向许多国家出口咖啡。

normal.en: The firm exports software to Asia.
normal.cn: 这家公司向亚洲出口软件。

normal.en: Tea was once a major export of China.
normal.cn: 茶叶曾是中国的主要出口商品。

normal.en: New rules made exporting easier.
normal.cn: 新规定让出口变得更容易。

normal.en: The port handles exports every day.
normal.cn: 这个港口每天处理出口货物。

abstract.en: Picture a ship loaded with boxes leaving port.
abstract.cn: 想象一艘装满箱子的船驶离港口。

abstract.en: Imagine a teacher sharing a method with another country.
abstract.cn: 想象一位老师把方法传到另一个国家。

abstract.en: Think of a map with arrows pointing outward.
abstract.cn: 想象一张地图，箭头全都指向外面。

examples.en: They export wine to Europe and America.
examples.cn: 他们把葡萄酒出口到欧洲和美洲。

examples.en: The country depends on oil exports.
examples.cn: 这个国家依赖石油出口。

examples.en: The company began exporting last year.
examples.cn: 这家公司去年开始出口。

dict_mnemonic.text: ex（向外）加 port（搬运）：把货物搬向国外，就是 export（出口）。

root: 源自拉丁语 exportare（运出去），由 ex-（向外）与 portare（搬运）构成，核心义「把货物或观念运出去」。

sensesIntro.en: Export means to sell goods abroad, to spread ideas outward, or goods sold abroad.
sensesIntro.cn: export 意为向国外销售货物、向外传播思想，或出口商品。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a container ship heading for a foreign port.
core.cn: 核心意象：驶向海外港口的集装箱船。

branches.en: The base sense is sending goods abroad.
branches.cn: 基础义是把货物运往国外。

branches.en: Goods are replaced by ideas that travel out.
branches.cn: 货物被向外传播的思想取代。

branches.en: The action becomes the goods themselves.
branches.cn: 动作变成货物本身。

branches.en: Trade and cultural spread both move outward.
branches.cn: 贸易与文化传播都向外流动。

branches.en: The act of exporting and the exports themselves are linked.
branches.cn: 出口行为与出口商品相互关联。

intro.en: Export is built on Latin ex- out and portare to carry, the same root as transport.
intro.cn: export 由拉丁语 ex-（向外）与 portare（搬运）构成，与 transport 同根。

latinIntro.en: Latin exportare, portare, and the prefix ex- are the source elements.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exportare、portare 与前缀 ex- 是来源要素。

items.meaning: to send goods abroad or such goods
items.example: They export rice to nearby markets.
items.exampleCN: 他们把大米出口到邻近市场。

items.structure: English verb form and plural noun
items.meaningCN: 出口（第三人称）；出口商品
items.exampleCN: 这个国家的出口大幅上升。

items.example: The exported fruit arrives by sea.
items.exampleCN: 出口的水果经海运输达。
出口需要仔细处理文书。

items.meaning: a person or country that exports
items.example: China is a major exporter of electronics.
items.exampleCN: 中国是电子产品的主要出口国。

items.example: The law controls the exportation of arms.

items.meaning: to carry from place to place

items.exampleCN: -port 出现在 export 与 import 中。

definition_en: to leave something open to danger or influence; to reveal a truth; to give someone experience of something
core_image: 遮布被掀开，里面的东西露在光下
scene: 不要把皮肤长时间暴露在阳光下。Do not expose your skin to the sun for long.
sceneCN: 这里 expose 是「使暴露于」（第 1 个义项）；句意：不要把皮肤长时间暴露在阳光下。

senses.title: Leave open to harm
senses.definition: to leave someone or something open to danger, weather, or influence
senses.definitionCN: 使某人或某物处于危险、天气或影响之下
senses.example: The damaged roof exposed the room to rain.
senses.exampleCN: 损坏的屋顶让雨水淋进了房间。
senses.why: The core sense is removing cover or protection.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是去掉遮盖或保护。

senses.title: Reveal a truth
senses.definition: to make a secret or wrong doing public
senses.definitionCN: 把秘密或错误行为公开
senses.example: The report exposed serious waste.
senses.exampleCN: 报告揭露了严重的浪费。
senses.why: Physical uncovering becomes moral disclosure.
senses.whyCN: 物理上的揭开转为道德上的揭发。

senses.title: Give experience
senses.definition: to give someone experience of something new
senses.definitionCN: 让某人接触或体验新事物
senses.example: Travel exposes children to other cultures.
senses.exampleCN: 旅行让孩子们接触其他文化。
senses.why: Being open to influence becomes learning.
senses.whyCN: 向影响敞开变成学习的过程。

intro.en: Expose comes from Latin exponere, to put out, from ex- out and ponere to place.
intro.cn: expose 来自拉丁语 exponere（放出去），由 ex-（向外）与 ponere（放置）构成。

items.en: Ex- means out.
items.cn: ex- 意为向外。

items.en: Ponere means to place.
items.cn: ponere 意为放置。

items.en: Exponere means to put out or set forth.
items.cn: exponere 意为放出或陈述。

items.en: Exposer carries the sense of setting out.
items.cn: 古法语 exposer 保留「摆出来」之义。

items.en: Expose means to uncover or reveal.
items.cn: 现代英语中 expose 意为使暴露或揭露。

note.en: Expose means uncover; oppose means stand against.
note.cn: expose 是揭开，oppose 则是反对。

entries.definition: to disagree with and try to stop
to remove a cover or find a secret

normalIntro.en: Expose is about taking away cover, whether from skin or from a secret.
normalIntro.cn: expose 指去掉遮盖，无论是皮肤上的还是秘密上的。

normal.en: Do not expose the film to bright light.
normal.cn: 不要让胶片暴露在强光下。

normal.en: The newspaper exposed the false claims.
normal.cn: 报纸揭露了那些虚假说法。

normal.en: Workers were exposed to dangerous fumes.
normal.cn: 工人们接触到了危险气体。

normal.en: The scandal exposed weak controls.
normal.cn: 这起丑闻暴露出监管薄弱。

normal.en: Good teachers expose students to new ideas.
normal.cn: 好老师让学生接触新思想。

abstract.en: Picture a cloth pulled away from a hidden object.
abstract.cn: 想象一块布从隐藏的物体上被拉开。

abstract.en: Imagine a spotlight falling on a dark corner.
abstract.cn: 想象一束聚光灯照进黑暗的角落。

abstract.en: Think of a door opened to let fresh air in.
abstract.cn: 想象一扇门打开，让新鲜空气进来。

examples.en: The report exposed waste in the department.
examples.cn: 报告揭露了该部门的浪费。

examples.en: Children should not be exposed to violence.
examples.cn: 不应让儿童接触暴力。

examples.en: The storm exposed the weakness of the roof.
examples.cn: 暴风雨暴露了屋顶的弱点。

dict_mnemonic.text: ex（向外）加 pose（放置）：把东西放到外面、不再遮住，就是 expose（暴露）。

root: 源自拉丁语 exponere（放出去），由 ex-（向外）与 ponere（放置）构成，核心义「去掉遮盖，使显露」。

sensesIntro.en: Expose means to leave something unprotected, to reveal a truth, or to give someone new experience.
sensesIntro.cn: expose 意为使失去保护、揭露真相，或让某人获得新体验。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a cover lifted off something hidden.
core.cn: 核心意象：遮盖物被从隐藏之物上掀开。

branches.en: The base sense is opening to harm.
branches.cn: 基础义是向伤害敞开。

branches.en: Physical uncovering becomes public disclosure.
branches.cn: 物理上的揭开变成公开揭露。

branches.en: Being open to influence becomes learning.
branches.cn: 向影响敞开变成学习。

branches.en: A hidden fault can be exposed to view.
branches.cn: 隐藏的缺陷可以被暴露在眼前。

branches.en: Exposure to risk and exposure to new ideas share the same openness.
branches.cn: 暴露于风险与接触新思想都带有「敞开」之意。

intro.en: Expose belongs to the Latin ponere family, like expose and composition.
intro.cn: expose 属于拉丁语 ponere 词族，与 composition 等词同源。

latinIntro.en: Latin exponere, ponere, and the prefix ex- are the source elements.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exponere、ponere 与前缀 ex- 是来源要素。

items.exampleCN: 他们揭露了有问题的线路。
这项测试暴露出薄弱之处。

items.example: The exposed pipe froze in winter.
items.exampleCN: 暴露的管道冬天冻住了。

items.example: Exposure to cold can be dangerous.

items.meaning: a full explanation or public show
items.example: The book begins with a short exposition.
items.exampleCN: 这本书以简短的阐述开篇。

items.example: The material is exposable to sunlight.
items.exampleCN: 这种材料可以暴露在阳光下。
许多居民反对这个计划。

items.meaning: to place an idea before oneself
items.example: I suppose he will arrive soon.

latinEntries.meaning: to put out or set forth

definition_en: the state of being unprotected; public attention in the media; the act of revealing a secret; experience of something
core_image: 一块遮布被掀开后，物体完全显露在众人眼前
scene: 长期暴露在噪音中会损害听力。Long exposure to noise can damage hearing.
sceneCN: 这里 exposure 是「暴露、接触」（第 1 个义项）；句意：长期暴露在噪音中会损害听力。

senses.title: Being unprotected
senses.definition: the state of being left open to danger, weather, or influence
senses.definitionCN: 处于危险、天气或影响之下的状态
senses.example: Exposure to cold can make you ill.
senses.exampleCN: 受寒可能让你生病。
senses.why: The core sense is openness to harm.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是向伤害敞开。

senses.title: Public attention
senses.definition: attention given by newspapers, television, or the internet
senses.definitionCN: 报纸、电视或网络给予的关注
senses.example: The film gained wide media exposure.
senses.exampleCN: 这部电影获得了广泛的媒体曝光。
senses.why: Being seen by many becomes public attention.
senses.whyCN: 被许多人看见转为公众关注。

senses.title: Revealing a secret
senses.definition: the act of making a secret or wrong doing public
senses.definitionCN: 把秘密或错误行为公开的行为
senses.example: The exposure of the fraud shocked investors.
senses.exampleCN: 骗局被揭露令投资者震惊。
senses.why: Uncovering becomes an act of disclosure.
senses.whyCN: 揭开变成公开披露的行为。

senses.title: Photographic exposure
senses.definition: the amount of light allowed to reach film or a sensor
senses.definitionCN: 允许到达胶片或传感器的光量
senses.example: The photo failed because of over exposure.
senses.exampleCN: 这张照片因曝光过度而失败。
senses.why: Openness to light becomes a technical term.
senses.whyCN: 向光敞开变成摄影术语。

intro.en: Exposure comes from expose plus the noun ending -ure, from Latin exponere.
intro.cn: exposure 由 expose 加名词词尾 -ure 构成，根源是拉丁语 exponere。

items.en: Exponere means to put out or set forth.
items.cn: exponere 意为放出或陈述。

items.en: The ending -ura forms nouns of action or state.
items.cn: 词尾 -ura 构成表示动作或状态的名词。

items.en: Exposure develops the sense of being laid open.
items.cn: exposure 发展出「被敞开」的含义。

items.en: Exposure names the state of being unprotected.
items.cn: exposure 指未受保护的状态。

items.en: Exposure covers media attention and photography.
items.cn: 现代英语中 exposure 涵盖媒体关注与摄影。

note.en: Exposure is being seen or uncovered; enclosure is being shut in.
note.cn: exposure 是被看见或揭开，enclosure 则是被围起来。

entries.definition: an area shut off by a fence
the act of making something public
the state of touching or meeting

normalIntro.en: Exposure is the noun form of expose, naming the state or act of being uncovered.
normalIntro.cn: exposure 是 expose 的名词形式，表示被揭开的状态或行为。

normal.en: Long exposure to sun can damage the skin.
normal.cn: 长时间日晒会损伤皮肤。

normal.en: The singer enjoys great exposure online.
normal.cn: 这位歌手在网上享有很高的曝光度。

normal.en: The exposure of the secret changed everything.
normal.cn: 秘密被揭露后，一切都变了。

normal.en: The camera needs a longer exposure at night.
normal.cn: 夜里拍摄需要更长的曝光时间。

normal.en: Workers demanded protection from chemical exposure.
normal.cn: 工人们要求防止化学品暴露。

abstract.en: Picture a spotlight sweeping over a hidden stage.
abstract.cn: 想象聚光灯扫过一个隐藏的舞台。

abstract.en: Imagine a sealed letter suddenly opened in public.
abstract.cn: 想象一封密封的信在众人面前突然被打开。

abstract.en: Think of a lens letting light fall on film.
abstract.cn: 想象镜头让光落在胶片上。

examples.en: The study measured exposure to pollution.
examples.cn: 这项研究测量了污染暴露程度。

examples.en: The scandal brought the company unwanted exposure.
examples.cn: 这起丑闻让公司得到了不想要的曝光。

examples.en: The exposure of the evidence led to a trial.

definition_en: to show thoughts or feelings; to send something quickly; fast and direct; a fast train or service
core_image: 把心里的想法像挤牙膏一样压出来，让对方看见

senses.title: Show thoughts

senses.exampleCN: 他写信表达了自己的感谢。

senses.title: Send quickly

senses.title: Fast and direct

senses.title: A fast service

definition_en: the act of showing thoughts or feelings; a look on the face; a word or phrase; a group of symbols in mathematics

senses.why: The core sense is pressing something out into view.

senses.title: Mathematical symbols

senses.definitionCN: 表示数学概念的一组符号

core.en: CORE IMAGE: feeling pressed out onto a face or into words.

definition_en: to reach out over an area; to make longer or larger; to stretch out a hand; to offer help or an invitation
core_image: 一条路从脚下一直伸向远方的地平线

sceneCN: 这里 extend 是「延伸」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这条小路一直延伸到河边。

senses.title: Reach across space
senses.definition: to reach out or continue over an area
senses.definitionCN: 在某片区域上伸展或延续
senses.example: The forest extends for miles.
senses.exampleCN: 森林延伸数英里。
senses.why: The core sense is stretching out in space.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是在空间中向外伸展。

senses.title: Make longer or larger
senses.definition: to make something longer, larger, or later
senses.definitionCN: 使某物更长、更大或更晚
senses.example: They extended the meeting by an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 他们把会议延长了一小时。
senses.why: Stretching in space becomes stretching in time or size.
senses.whyCN: 空间上的拉伸变成时间或规模上的延长。

senses.title: Stretch out a hand
senses.definition: to stretch out a part of the body
senses.definitionCN: 伸出身体的某一部分
senses.example: He extended his hand in greeting.
senses.exampleCN: 他伸出手来表示问候。
senses.why: The body repeats the outward stretch.
senses.whyCN: 身体重复了向外伸展的动作。

senses.title: Offer to someone

senses.definitionCN: 给予帮助、感谢或邀请
senses.example: The school extended a warm welcome to us.
senses.exampleCN: 学校向我们表示了热烈欢迎。
senses.why: Reaching outward becomes offering something.
senses.whyCN: 向外伸手变成给出某物。

note.cn: extension 是延长，tension 则是拉紧。

entries.definition: the state of being stretched tight
the act of watching or listening carefully
the act of making something last longer
an extra building added to a main one

normalIntro.en: Extension is the noun of extend, covering added space, added time, and added phone lines.
normalIntro.cn: extension 是 extend 的名词，涵盖加建空间、延长时间与电话分线。

normal.en: The library needs an extension at the back.
normal.cn: 图书馆需要在后面加建一部分。

normal.en: She asked for an extension on the essay.
normal.cn: 她申请延长交论文的期限。

normal.en: Please dial extension thirty five.
normal.cn: 请拨分机三十五。

normal.en: The extension of the road eased traffic.
normal.cn: 道路的延伸缓解了交通。

normal.en: He plugged the lamp into an extension lead.
normal.cn: 他把台灯插到延长线插座上。

abstract.en: Picture a small room added to the side of a house.
abstract.cn: 想象房子侧面加出一个小房间。

abstract.en: Imagine a clock whose hands move more slowly.
abstract.cn: 想象一只指针走得更慢的钟。

abstract.en: Think of one main road splitting into a side lane.
abstract.cn: 想象一条主路分出一条侧道。

examples.en: The council approved the extension of the school.
examples.cn: 议会批准了学校的扩建。

examples.en: He was given a two week extension.
examples.cn: 他获得了两周的延期。

examples.en: Her office extension is not working.
examples.cn: 她办公室的分机坏了。

dict_mnemonic.text: extend 加名词后缀 -sion，表示「延伸出来的部分」，就是 extension。

root: 源自拉丁语 extensio（向外伸展），由 extendere 派生，核心义「延伸、加出来的部分」。

sensesIntro.en: Extension means the act of extending, an added building, extra time, or a phone branch line.
sensesIntro.cn: extension 意为延伸行为、加建部分、额外时间，或电话分机。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a new room attached to an old house.
core.cn: 核心意象：老房子旁新接出的一间房。

branches.en: The base sense is the act of stretching out.
branches.cn: 基础义是向外伸展的行为。

branches.en: The act becomes an added structure.
branches.cn: 动作变成加建的结构。

branches.en: Stretching in space becomes extra time.
branches.cn: 空间延伸变成额外时间。

branches.en: A branch line extends from the main line.
branches.cn: 分线从主线上延伸出来。

branches.en: The act of extending and its built result are linked.
branches.cn: 延伸行为与其建成的结果相互关联。

intro.en: Extension is extend plus -sion, a noun ending seen in expansion and tension.
intro.cn: extension 由 extend 加 -sion 构成，-sion 是见于 expansion、tension 的名词词尾。

latinIntro.en: Latin extensio and extendere are the source forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 extensio 与 extendere 是来源形式。

items.meaning: the act of extending or an added part
items.example: The extension was finished in May.

items.meaning: several added parts or branch lines

items.example: They extend the service in winter.
items.exampleCN: 他们在冬天延长服务时间。

items.example: The extent of the loss is unknown.

definition_en: covering a large area; very great in amount; wide in range
core_image: 一片望不到边的田野铺展在眼前
scene: 这场风暴造成了广泛破坏。The storm caused extensive damage.
sceneCN: 这里 extensive 是「大量的、大规模的」（第 2 个义项）；句意：这场风暴造成了广泛破坏。

senses.title: Wide in range
senses.definition: covering a large area or range
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖大片区域或很大范围的
senses.example: The project required extensive research.
senses.exampleCN: 这个项目需要广泛的研究。
senses.why: The core sense is a wide stretch of coverage.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是覆盖面的大幅铺展。

senses.title: Very great in amount
senses.definition: very great in amount or degree
senses.definitionCN: 数量或程度非常大的
senses.example: The flood caused extensive damage.
senses.exampleCN: 洪水造成了大规模破坏。
senses.why: Wide range becomes great amount.
senses.whyCN: 宽广的范围变成巨大的数量。

senses.title: Covering much land
senses.definition: covering a large area of land
senses.definitionCN: 覆盖大片土地的
senses.example: The house has extensive gardens.
senses.exampleCN: 这座房子有宽阔的花园。
senses.why: The stretch of space is the oldest sense.
senses.whyCN: 空间的铺展是最早的含义。

intro.en: Extensive comes from Latin extensivus, from extendere, to stretch out.
intro.cn: extensive 来自拉丁语 extensivus，根源是 extendere（向外拉伸）。

items.en: Extendere means to stretch out.
items.cn: extendere 意为向外拉伸。

items.en: Extensivus means tending to stretch out.
items.cn: extensivus 意为倾向于向外伸展的。

items.en: Extensive describes wide areas and large amounts.
items.cn: extensive 描述广阔区域与大量事物。

items.en: Extensive appears in research and damage.
items.cn: 现代英语中 extensive 常用于研究与破坏。

items.en: Extend, extension, and extent share the root.
items.cn: extend、extension 与 extent 共享同一词根。

note.en: Extensive means wide; intensive means deep and concentrated.
note.cn: extensive 是广泛的，intensive 则是密集深入的。

entries.definition: involving a lot of effort in a short time

normalIntro.en: Extensive describes things that spread wide or reach a great amount.
normalIntro.cn: extensive 描述铺展得很广或数量很大的事物。

normal.en: The report is based on extensive research.
normal.cn: 这份报告基于广泛的研究。

normal.en: The fire caused extensive damage to the forest.
normal.cn: 大火对森林造成了大规模破坏。

normal.en: She has extensive knowledge of local history.
normal.cn: 她对当地历史有广博的知识。

normal.en: The estate has extensive grounds.
normal.cn: 这座庄园有宽阔的场地。

normal.en: Extensive use of plastic worries scientists.
normal.cn: 塑料的广泛使用让科学家担忧。

abstract.en: Picture a field that runs far beyond sight.
abstract.cn: 想象一片一直延伸到视线之外的田野。

abstract.en: Imagine a map covered with many small marks.
abstract.cn: 想象一张布满许多小标记的地图。

abstract.en: Think of a library with shelves in every room.
abstract.cn: 想象一座每个房间都摆满书架的图书馆。

examples.en: The storm caused extensive damage to the coast.
examples.cn: 风暴对海岸造成了大规模破坏。

examples.en: They carried out extensive tests.
examples.cn: 他们进行了广泛的测试。

examples.en: The castle has extensive gardens.
examples.cn: 这座城堡有宽阔的花园。

dict_mnemonic.text: extend（延伸）加 -ive：延伸得很开的，就是 extensive（广泛的）。

root: 源自拉丁语 extensivus，由 extendere（向外拉伸）派生，核心义「铺展得很广、数量很大」。

sensesIntro.en: Extensive means wide in range, very great in amount, or covering much land.
sensesIntro.cn: extensive 意为范围广泛、数量巨大，或覆盖大片土地。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a field stretching beyond sight.
core.cn: 核心意象：延伸到视线之外的田野。

branches.en: The base sense is wide coverage.
branches.cn: 基础义是宽广的覆盖范围。

branches.en: Wide range becomes a great amount.
branches.cn: 宽广范围变成巨大数量。

branches.en: The oldest sense is land stretched out.
branches.cn: 最早的含义是铺展开的土地。

branches.en: Wide range and large amount often go together.
branches.cn: 范围广与数量大常常相伴。

branches.en: Coverage in research and in land share the same width.
branches.cn: 研究范围与土地面积共享同一种「广」。

intro.en: Extensive is extend plus -ive, and it belongs to the same family as extension and extent.
intro.cn: extensive 由 extend 加 -ive 构成，与 extension、extent 同族。

latinIntro.en: Latin extensivus and extendere are the source forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 extensivus 与 extendere 是来源形式。

items.meaning: in a wide or thorough way
items.example: The subject has been studied extensively.
items.exampleCN: 这个课题已被广泛研究。

items.example: They measured the extensiveness of the damage.
items.exampleCN: 他们评估了破坏的广泛程度。
他们建了一个扩建部分。

items.example: The extent of the damage is unknown.

items.exampleCN: 他参加了一个强化课程。

items.example: The room has an expansive view.

definition_en: the degree to which something happens; the size or range of something; a limit
core_image: 一把尺子量出一件事延伸到哪里、有多深
scene: 损坏的程度仍然未知。The extent of the damage is still unknown.
sceneCN: 这里 extent 是「范围、程度」（第 2 个义项）；句意：损坏的程度仍然未知。

senses.title: Degree
senses.definition: the degree to which something happens or is true
senses.definitionCN: 某事发生或成立的程度
senses.example: I agree with you to some extent.
senses.exampleCN: 我在某种程度上同意你。
senses.why: The core sense is how far a quality reaches.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是某种性质延伸到多远。

senses.title: Size or range
senses.definition: the size, area, or range of something
senses.definitionCN: 某物的大小、面积或范围
senses.example: The extent of the forest surprised us.
senses.exampleCN: 森林的范围让我们惊讶。
senses.why: Degree in an abstract sense becomes physical size.
senses.whyCN: 抽象程度变成具体的大小范围。

senses.title: A limit
senses.definition: the limit beyond which something does not go
senses.definitionCN: 某事物不再超出的界限
senses.example: He went to the full extent of his power.
senses.exampleCN: 他用尽了权力的全部限度。
senses.why: The far edge of a stretch becomes a limit.
senses.whyCN: 伸展的最远端变成限度。

intro.en: Extent comes from Old French estente, from Latin extendere, to stretch out.
intro.cn: extent 来自古法语 estente，根源是拉丁语 extendere（向外拉伸）。

items.en: Extendere means to stretch out.
items.cn: extendere 意为向外拉伸。

items.en: Estente means a stretch or reach.
items.cn: estente 意为伸展或延伸的范围。

items.en: Extent names the reach of a thing.
items.cn: extent 指事物的延伸范围。

items.en: Extent also means degree.
items.cn: extent 也表示程度。

items.en: To some extent becomes a common phrase.
items.cn: to some extent 成为常用短语。

note.en: Extent is how far; extend is the verb to stretch.
note.cn: extent 是延伸的程度，extend 则是拉伸的动词。

entries.definition: the level or amount of something
the size or level of something

normalIntro.en: Extent measures how far something reaches or how true it is.
normalIntro.cn: extent 衡量事物延伸到多远，或成立到什么程度。

normal.en: To some extent, the plan worked well.
normal.cn: 在某种程度上，这个计划很奏效。

normal.en: The extent of the damage is still unknown.
normal.cn: 损坏的范围仍然未知。

normal.en: We were shocked by the extent of the poverty.
normal.cn: 贫困的程度让我们震惊。

normal.en: To a large extent, success depends on practice.
normal.cn: 成功在很大程度上取决于练习。

normal.en: He pushed the machine to its full extent.
normal.cn: 他把机器用到了极限。

abstract.en: Picture a ruler laid across an unknown distance.
abstract.cn: 想象一把尺子横在一段未知的距离上。

abstract.en: Imagine a scale that marks how strong a feeling is.
abstract.cn: 想象一把标出情绪强弱程度的刻度尺。

abstract.en: Think of a boundary set at the far edge.
abstract.cn: 想象在远端划出的一条界限。

examples.en: The extent of the flood damage is not clear.
examples.cn: 洪水破坏的范围尚不清楚。

examples.en: To some extent, I understand your choice.
examples.cn: 在某种程度上，我理解你的选择。

examples.en: They explored the full extent of the cave.
examples.cn: 他们探索了洞穴的全部范围。

dict_mnemonic.text: extent 与 extend 同源，动词是「延伸」，名词就是「延伸到的程度与范围」。

root: 源自古法语 estente，追溯到拉丁语 extendere（向外拉伸），核心义「延伸所达到的程度与范围」。

sensesIntro.en: Extent means the degree of something, its size or range, or a limit.
sensesIntro.cn: extent 意为某事的程度、其大小范围，或限度。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ruler measuring how far something reaches.
core.cn: 核心意象：一把量出延伸距离的尺子。

branches.en: The base sense is the degree a quality reaches.
branches.cn: 基础义是某种性质达到的程度。

branches.en: Abstract degree becomes physical size.
branches.cn: 抽象程度变成具体大小。

branches.en: The far edge of a stretch becomes a limit.
branches.cn: 伸展的最远端变成限度。

branches.en: Degree and range both answer how far.
branches.cn: 程度与范围都在回答「有多远」。

branches.en: Size and limit mark the ends of the same measure.
branches.cn: 大小与限度标记同一把尺子的两端。

intro.en: Extent belongs to the extend family and shares the Latin root tendere.
intro.cn: extent 属于 extend 词族，共享拉丁词根 tendere。

latinIntro.en: Latin extendere and tendere lie behind extent.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 extendere 与 tendere 是 extent 的来源。

items.example: The extent of the loss was huge.
The report compares the extents of damage.
items.exampleCN: 报告比较了各处的损坏范围。

items.example: He has a tendency to worry.

items.exampleCN: 房间里的紧张气氛加剧。

items.meaning: a shelter held by stretched cloth
items.example: They pitched a tent by the lake.

definition_en: the outside of something; the way something looks from outside; outer
core_image: 一栋房子从街上看过去的外墙与屋顶
scene: 这栋楼的外墙刷成了白色。The exterior of the building is painted white.
sceneCN: 这里 exterior 是「外部、外面」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这栋楼的外墙刷成了白色。

senses.title: The outside
senses.definition: the outer surface or outside of something
senses.definitionCN: 某物的外表面或外部
senses.example: The exterior of the house needs paint.
senses.exampleCN: 房子的外墙需要刷漆。
senses.why: The core sense is the outer side of a thing.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是事物的外侧。

senses.title: Outward appearance
senses.definition: the way someone or something looks from outside
senses.definitionCN: 人或物从外面看起来的样子
senses.example: Despite his calm exterior, he was worried.
senses.exampleCN: 尽管外表平静，他其实很担心。
senses.why: The outer surface becomes a show of appearance.
senses.whyCN: 外表面变成呈现出来的样子。

senses.title: Outer
senses.definition: on or from the outside
senses.definitionCN: 位于外部或来自外部的
senses.example: The exterior walls are very thick.
senses.exampleCN: 外墙非常厚。
senses.why: The noun becomes an adjective of position.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为表示位置的形容词。

intro.en: Exterior comes from Latin exterior, the comparative of exterus, outward.
intro.cn: exterior 来自拉丁语 exterior，是 exterus（向外的）的比较级。

items.en: Exterus means outward or foreign.
items.cn: exterus 意为向外的或外来的。

items.en: Exterior means more outward.
items.cn: exterior 意为更靠外的。

items.en: The word contrasts with interior.
items.cn: 这个词与 interior 相对。

items.en: Exterior reaches English through French forms.
items.cn: exterior 经法语形式进入英语。

items.en: Exterior names both the outside and its look.
items.cn: 现代英语中 exterior 兼指外部与外观。

note.en: Exterior is the outside; interior is the inside.
note.cn: exterior 是外部，interior 则是内部。

entries.definition: pointing or facing away from the inside

normalIntro.en: Exterior is the outside surface and the look it presents.
normalIntro.cn: exterior 指外表面以及它呈现出来的样子。

normal.en: The exterior of the car was dusty.
normal.cn: 汽车的外表布满灰尘。

normal.en: They painted the exterior walls last summer.
normal.cn: 他们去年夏天刷了外墙。

normal.en: His cheerful exterior hid a deep sadness.
normal.cn: 他愉快的外表掩盖着深深的悲伤。

normal.en: The building's exterior is made of stone.
normal.cn: 这栋楼的外墙是石头做的。

normal.en: Exterior lighting makes the path safe at night.
normal.cn: 室外照明让夜间的小路安全。

abstract.en: Picture a house seen from the street at dusk.
abstract.cn: 想象黄昏时从街上看到的一栋房子。

abstract.en: Imagine a calm face covering a worried mind.
abstract.cn: 想象一张平静的脸掩盖着担忧的心。

abstract.en: Think of a shell protecting what lies inside.
abstract.cn: 想象一层外壳保护着里面的东西。

examples.en: The exterior of the museum is plain stone.
examples.cn: 博物馆的外墙是朴素的石头。

examples.en: She kept a calm exterior during the interview.
examples.cn: 面试时她保持着平静的外表。

examples.en: Exterior doors must be kept locked.
examples.cn: 外门必须保持上锁。

dict_mnemonic.text: exterior 与 external 同源，都表示「外面的」；exterior 更强调外表与外观。

root: 源自拉丁语 exterior（更靠外的），是 exterus（向外的）的比较级，核心义「外部与外观」。

sensesIntro.en: Exterior means the outside of something, its outward appearance, or outer.
sensesIntro.cn: exterior 意为某物的外部、其外观，或外部的。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a house wall facing the street.
core.cn: 核心意象：朝向街道的一面房屋外墙。

branches.en: The base sense is the outside of a thing.
branches.cn: 基础义是事物的外侧。

branches.en: The surface becomes the look presented to others.
branches.cn: 表面变成呈现给他人的样子。

branches.en: The noun becomes an adjective of position.
branches.cn: 名词转为表示位置的形容词。

branches.en: The outside and its appearance are closely linked.
branches.cn: 外部与其外观紧密相连。

branches.en: Outward appearance and outer position both face away from the inside.
branches.cn: 外表与外位都朝向内部之外。

intro.en: Exterior belongs to the Latin exterus family, like external and extreme.
intro.cn: exterior 属于拉丁语 exterus 词族，与 external、extreme 同源。

latinIntro.en: Latin exterus and exterior are the source forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 exterus 与 exterior 是来源形式。

items.example: The book shows the exteriors of old houses.
items.exampleCN: 这本书展示了老房子的外部。

items.example: The idea of exteriority is central here.
items.exampleCN: 外在性的概念在这里很重要。

items.example: The interior is warm and bright.
He externalized his fears in art.
items.exampleCN: 他在艺术中把恐惧外化。

latinEntries.example: Extra is related to the outer family.

definition_en: on or from the outside; coming from another place or group; relating to foreign countries
core_image: 一股来自屋外的风推开窗户
scene: 外部压力迫使公司改变计划。External pressure forced the company to change its plan.
sceneCN: 这里 external 是「外来的」（第 2 个义项）；句意：外部压力迫使公司改变计划。

senses.title: On the outside
senses.definition: located on or forming the outside of something
senses.definitionCN: 位于外部或构成外部的
senses.example: The external walls are painted white.
senses.exampleCN: 外墙被刷成白色。
senses.why: The core sense is physical position outside.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是位于外部的物理位置。

senses.title: Coming from outside
senses.definition: coming from another place, person, or system
senses.definitionCN: 来自其他地方、人或系统的
senses.example: External pressure changed the decision.
senses.exampleCN: 外部压力改变了决定。
senses.why: Position becomes the source of influence.
senses.whyCN: 位置变成影响的来源。

senses.title: Relating to foreign affairs
senses.definition: relating to relations with other countries
senses.definitionCN: 与别国关系有关的
senses.example: He works in external affairs.
senses.exampleCN: 他从事对外事务。
senses.why: The outside of a country is the foreign world.
senses.whyCN: 一个国家的「外部」就是外国世界。

intro.en: External comes from Latin externus, from exterus, meaning outward.
intro.cn: external 来自拉丁语 externus，根源是 exterus（向外的）。

items.en: Exterus means outward or foreign.
items.cn: exterus 意为向外的或外来的。

items.en: Externus means belonging to the outside.
items.cn: externus 意为属于外部的。

items.en: The word contrasts with internus, inner.
items.cn: 这个词与表示内部的 internus 相对。

items.en: External names what lies outside a system.
items.cn: external 指位于系统之外的事物。

items.en: External covers foreign affairs and devices.
items.cn: 现代英语中 external 涵盖对外事务与外接设备。

note.en: External is outside; internal is inside.
note.cn: external 是外部的，internal 则是内部的。

entries.definition: not inside a building or group

normalIntro.en: External marks what is outside a person, system, or country.
normalIntro.cn: external 标记人或系统、国家之外的事物。

normal.en: External doors must be locked at night.
normal.cn: 外门夜间必须上锁。

normal.en: The company faced strong external pressure.
normal.cn: 公司面临强大的外部压力。

normal.en: An external drive stores extra files.
normal.cn: 外置硬盘用来存放额外文件。

normal.en: The medicine is for external use only.
normal.cn: 这种药仅供外用。

normal.en: External factors slowed the economy.
normal.cn: 外部因素让经济放缓。

abstract.en: Picture wind pushing a window open from outside.
abstract.cn: 想象风从外面把窗户吹开。

abstract.en: Imagine a voice entering a quiet room through the door.
abstract.cn: 想象一个声音从门缝进入安静的房间。

abstract.en: Think of a country looking outward across its border.
abstract.cn: 想象一个国家越过边界向外看。

examples.en: External pressure forced the manager to resign.
examples.cn: 外部压力迫使经理辞职。

examples.en: The external surface is rough and cold.
examples.cn: 外表面粗糙而冰冷。

examples.en: The country changed its external policy.
examples.cn: 这个国家改变了对外政策。

dict_mnemonic.text: extern 表示「外部」，加形容词后缀 -al，就是 external（外部的）。

root: 源自拉丁语 externus（外部的），由 exterus（向外的）派生，核心义「位于或来自外部」。

sensesIntro.en: External means on the outside, coming from outside, or relating to foreign affairs.
sensesIntro.cn: external 意为位于外部、来自外部，或与对外事务有关。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: wind entering from outside a room.
core.cn: 核心意象：从屋外进入房间的风。

branches.en: The base sense is physical position outside.
branches.cn: 基础义是外部的物理位置。

branches.en: Position becomes the source of influence.
branches.cn: 位置变成影响的来源。

branches.en: The outside of a country is the foreign world.
branches.cn: 国家的「外部」就是外国世界。

branches.en: Outer walls and outside pressure share the same boundary.
branches.cn: 外墙与外部压力共享同一条边界。

branches.en: Outside forces and foreign affairs both cross a border.
branches.cn: 外部力量与对外事务都越过边界。

intro.en: External is exterus plus -al, and it belongs with exterior and extreme.
intro.cn: external 由 exterus 加 -al 构成，与 exterior、extreme 同族。

latinIntro.en: Latin externus, exterus, and the suffix -alis are the source elements.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 externus、exterus 与词尾 -alis 是来源要素。

items.example: She externalized her feelings in a letter.
items.exampleCN: 她在信里把感情表达出来。
污染是典型的外部性问题。

items.example: The exterior is made of brick.
Internal doors are made of wood.

definition_zh: 额外的；额外地；额外的东西
definition_en: more than usual or needed; in addition; something added or charged in addition
core_image: 账单末尾又多出来的一行小字，写着额外费用
scene: 住店要另收额外费用。The hotel charges an extra fee.
sceneCN: 这里 extra 是「额外的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：住店要另收额外费用。

senses.title: More than usual
senses.definition: more than what is usual, expected, or needed
senses.definitionCN: 多于平常、预期或所需的
senses.example: We need an extra chair for the guest.
senses.exampleCN: 我们需要为客人多加一把椅子。
senses.why: The core sense is something added beyond the norm.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是超出常规而增加的东西。

senses.title: In addition
senses.definition: in addition to what is already there
senses.definitionCN: 在已有事物之外再加
senses.example: You have to pay extra for breakfast.
senses.exampleCN: 早餐需要另外付费。
senses.why: The adjective becomes an adverb of addition.
senses.whyCN: 形容词转为表示「额外增加」的副词。

senses.title: Something added
senses.definition: an additional item or charge
senses.definitionCN: 额外增加的项目或费用
senses.example: The room is small but the extras are free.
senses.exampleCN: 房间不大，但附加项目免费。
senses.why: The quality becomes a countable thing.
senses.whyCN: 性质变成可数的具体事物。

intro.en: Extra comes from Latin extra, outside, and later shortens extraordinary.
intro.cn: extra 来自拉丁语 extra（在外面），后来也用作 extraordinary 的缩写。

items.en: Extra means outside or beyond.
items.cn: extra 意为在外面或超出。

items.en: The word appears in phrases of addition.
items.cn: 这个词出现在表示附加的短语中。

items.en: Extra becomes a short form of extraordinary.
items.cn: 英语中 extra 成为 extraordinary 的缩略形式。

items.en: Extra comes to mean additional.
items.cn: extra 逐渐表示「额外的」。

items.en: Extra covers charges, items, and effort.
items.cn: 现代英语中 extra 涵盖费用、物品与额外努力。

note.en: Extra means additional; extreme means farthest.
note.cn: extra 是额外的，extreme 则是极端的。

normalIntro.en: Extra marks anything added beyond the usual amount.
normalIntro.cn: extra 标记超出平常数量而增加的任何东西。

normal.en: We stayed an extra night in the city.
normal.cn: 我们在城里多住了一晚。

normal.en: The airline charges extra for heavy bags.
normal.cn: 航空公司对超重行李额外收费。

normal.en: She earns extra money by teaching at night.
normal.cn: 她晚上教书挣外快。

normal.en: The team practiced extra before the final.
normal.cn: 决赛前球队加练了。

normal.en: The meal comes with extra bread.
normal.cn: 这顿饭附赠额外的面包。

abstract.en: Picture one more box added to a full shelf.
abstract.cn: 想象在满架上又加了一只箱子。

abstract.en: Imagine a bill with one small added line.
abstract.cn: 想象账单末尾多出一行小字。

abstract.en: Think of a clock with one bonus hour.
abstract.cn: 想象一天多出一个小时。

examples.en: The hotel charges extra for parking.
examples.cn: 酒店对停车额外收费。

examples.en: Take an extra sweater in case it turns cold.
examples.cn: 多带一件毛衣，以防天气转冷。

examples.en: The price includes all extras.
examples.cn: 价格包含所有附加项目。

dict_mnemonic.text: extra 来自拉丁语「在外面」，放到账单或计划之外，就是「额外的」。

root: 源自拉丁语 extra（在外面、超出），核心义「在常规之外另加的」。

sensesIntro.en: Extra means more than usual, in addition, or an added item or charge.
sensesIntro.cn: extra 意为超出平常的、额外地，或额外项目与费用。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one more item added beyond the list.
core.cn: 核心意象：清单之外又添的一项。

branches.en: The base sense is something beyond the usual.
branches.cn: 基础义是超出平常的事物。

branches.en: The adjective becomes an adverb of addition.
branches.cn: 形容词变成表示附加的副词。

branches.en: The quality becomes a countable item.
branches.cn: 性质变成可数的项目。

branches.en: More than usual and in addition describe the same surplus.
branches.cn: 超出平常与额外增加描述同一种盈余。

branches.en: An extra chair and an extra charge are both additions.
branches.cn: 多一把椅子与多一笔费用都是附加。

intro.en: Extra comes from Latin extra, outside, and shares a family with extraordinary and extraneous.
intro.cn: extra 来自拉丁语 extra（在外面），与 extraordinary、extraneous 同族。

latinIntro.en: Latin extra meaning outside is the source form.
latinIntro.cn: 表示「在外面」的拉丁语 extra 是来源形式。

items.example: The car comes with several extras.
items.exampleCN: 这辆车配有若干附加项目。

items.meaning: coming from outside and not needed

items.exampleCN: extra- 出现在 extraordinary 中。

items.meaning: a person who turns outward to others
items.exampleCN: 这个外向的人很快交了朋友。

latinEntries.example: Exterus belongs to the same family.

latinEntries.exampleCN: extraordinary 由 extra 与 ordinary 组合。

definition_en: very unusual and impressive; much greater than usual; strange and surprising
core_image: 一朵普通花丛中突然开出的巨大奇异花朵
scene: 她展现出非凡的勇气。She showed extraordinary courage.
sceneCN: 这里 extraordinary 是「非凡的、出色的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她展现出非凡的勇气。

senses.title: Far beyond usual
senses.definition: much greater or better than usual
senses.definitionCN: 远超过平常水平或质量的
senses.example: She showed extraordinary courage.
senses.exampleCN: 她展现出非凡的勇气。
senses.why: The core sense is standing outside the ordinary.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是站在平常之外。

senses.title: Very unusual
senses.definition: very unusual and not happening often
senses.definitionCN: 非常不寻常且不常发生的
senses.example: The team met under extraordinary circumstances.
senses.exampleCN: 团队在特殊情况下开会。
senses.why: Rare events stand outside normal rules.
senses.whyCN: 罕见事件站在常规之外。

senses.title: Strange and surprising
senses.definition: so strange that it surprises people
senses.definitionCN: 奇怪到令人惊讶的
senses.example: He told an extraordinary story about the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 他讲了一个关于大海的离奇故事。
senses.why: The unusual becomes the astonishing.
senses.whyCN: 不寻常变成令人惊异。

intro.en: Extraordinary joins Latin extra, outside, and ordinarius, ordinary.
intro.cn: extraordinary 由拉丁语 extra（在外面）与 ordinarius（普通的）组合而成。

items.en: Extra means outside or beyond.
items.cn: extra 意为在外面或超出。

items.en: Ordinarius means ordinary or usual.
items.cn: ordinarius 意为普通的、通常的。

items.en: The pieces mean outside the ordinary.
items.cn: 两部分合起来意为「超出普通」。

items.en: The word passes through French into English.
items.cn: 这个词经法语进入英语。

items.en: Extraordinary covers greatness and strangeness.
items.cn: 现代英语中 extraordinary 涵盖卓越与离奇。

note.en: Extraordinary is beyond ordinary; ordinary is usual.
note.cn: extraordinary 是超出普通的，ordinary 则是平常的。

normalIntro.en: Extraordinary describes what stands far outside the ordinary.
normalIntro.cn: extraordinary 描述远远站在普通之外的事物。

normal.en: She has an extraordinary memory for names.
normal.cn: 她对名字有非凡的记忆力。

normal.en: The rescue was an extraordinary effort.
normal.cn: 这次救援是非凡的努力。

normal.en: They met under extraordinary circumstances.
normal.cn: 他们在特殊情况下会面。

normal.en: The painting is quite extraordinary.
normal.cn: 这幅画相当不寻常。

normal.en: He told an extraordinary tale of survival.
normal.cn: 他讲了一个离奇的生存故事。

abstract.en: Picture one huge flower rising above a plain field.
abstract.cn: 想象一朵巨大的花从普通田野中升起。

abstract.en: Imagine a quiet town where something amazing happens.
abstract.cn: 想象一个安静小镇上发生了惊人的事。

abstract.en: Think of a person who does what no one thought possible.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人做到了大家认为不可能的事。

examples.en: The doctor made an extraordinary effort to save him.
examples.cn: 医生为救他付出了非凡的努力。

examples.en: It was an extraordinary coincidence.
examples.cn: 这是一个离奇的巧合。

examples.en: The team showed extraordinary skill.
examples.cn: 这支队伍展现了非凡的技巧。

dict_mnemonic.text: extra（超出）加 ordinary（普通）：超出普通的，就是 extraordinary（非凡的）。

root: 由拉丁语 extra（超出）与 ordinarius（普通）组合而来，核心义「超出普通、非同寻常」。

sensesIntro.en: Extraordinary means far beyond usual, very unusual, or strange and surprising.
sensesIntro.cn: extraordinary 意为远超平常、非常不寻常，或离奇惊人。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one huge flower above a plain field.
core.cn: 核心意象：普通田野上高出一切的一朵巨花。

branches.en: The base sense is greatness beyond the usual.
branches.cn: 基础义是超出平常的卓越。

branches.en: Rare events stand outside normal rules.
branches.cn: 罕见事件站在常规之外。

branches.en: The unusual becomes astonishing.
branches.cn: 不寻常变成令人惊异。

branches.en: Great ability and rare events both exceed the norm.
branches.cn: 卓越能力与罕见事件都超出常规。

branches.en: Special circumstances often produce strange stories.
branches.cn: 特殊情况常常产生离奇故事。

intro.en: Extraordinary is a compound of extra and ordinary, with a large family of related words.
intro.cn: extraordinary 是 extra 与 ordinary 的复合词，拥有一个较大的相关词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin extra and ordinarius are the two source elements.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 extra 与 ordinarius 是两个来源要素。

items.example: The extraordinariness of the event shocked us.
items.exampleCN: 这件事的离奇让我们震惊。

items.example: Ordinarily, the shop closes at six.

latinEntries.exampleCN: ordo 是 ordinarius 的词源。

definition_en: very great in degree; far from what is usual or moderate; the furthest point
core_image: 温度计的水银柱冲到最顶端
scene: 该地区正经历极端天气。The region is experiencing extreme weather.
sceneCN: 这里 extreme 是「极度的、极端的」（第 1 个义项）；句意：该地区正经历极端天气。

senses.title: Very great in degree
senses.definition: very great in degree or intensity
senses.definitionCN: 程度或强度非常大的
senses.example: The desert reaches extreme temperatures.
senses.exampleCN: 沙漠会达到极端温度。
senses.why: The core sense is the farthest point of a scale.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是刻度上最远的一点。

senses.title: Far from moderate
senses.definition: far from what is usual, moderate, or acceptable
senses.definitionCN: 远离通常、温和或可接受范围的
senses.example: The group holds extreme views.
senses.exampleCN: 这个团体持有极端观点。
senses.why: The far end of a scale becomes a political judgment.
senses.whyCN: 刻度的远端变成政治判断。

senses.title: The furthest point
senses.definition: the furthest or most severe point of something
senses.definitionCN: 某事物最远或最严重的点
senses.example: The two extremes rarely meet.
senses.exampleCN: 两个极端很少相遇。
senses.why: The adjective becomes the endpoint itself.
senses.whyCN: 形容词变成端点本身。

intro.en: Extreme comes from Latin extremus, the superlative of exterus, outward.
intro.cn: extreme 来自拉丁语 extremus，是 exterus（向外的）的最高级。

items.en: Exterus means outward.
items.cn: exterus 意为向外的。

items.en: Extremus means farthest out.
items.cn: extremus 意为最靠外的。

items.en: Extreme passes through French into English.
items.cn: extreme 经法语进入英语。

items.en: Extreme describes the far end of a scale.
items.cn: extreme 描述刻度的最远端。

items.en: Extreme also describes severe weather and views.
items.cn: 现代英语中 extreme 也形容极端天气与观点。

note.en: Extreme is the far end; extra is an addition.
note.cn: extreme 是最远端，extra 则是额外添加。

entries.definition: to pass waste out of the body

normalIntro.en: Extreme points to the farthest end of any scale.
normalIntro.cn: extreme 指向任何刻度的最远端。

normal.en: The region suffers extreme heat in summer.
normal.cn: 这个地区夏天酷热难耐。

normal.en: They took extreme measures to stop the fire.
normal.cn: 他们采取极端措施阻止大火。

normal.en: The family lives in extreme poverty.
normal.cn: 这家人生活在极度贫困中。

normal.en: Do not go to extremes in dieting.
normal.cn: 节食不要走极端。

normal.en: At the other extreme, the lake is frozen.
normal.cn: 在另一个极端，湖面结着冰。

abstract.en: Picture a thermometer pushed to its highest mark.
abstract.cn: 想象温度计的水银冲到最高点。

abstract.en: Imagine a road ending at a cliff edge.
abstract.cn: 想象一条路终止在悬崖边。

abstract.en: Think of a scale with weights at both ends.
abstract.cn: 想象天平两端都压着砝码。

examples.en: The mountain is dangerous in extreme weather.
examples.cn: 在极端天气下，这座山很危险。

examples.en: Their views are too extreme for most voters.
examples.cn: 他们的观点对多数选民来说太极端。

examples.en: The temperature swung from one extreme to the other.
examples.cn: 温度从一个极端摆到另一个极端。

dict_mnemonic.text: extreme 与 extra 同源：extra 是「超出」，extreme 是「超出到最远端」，即极端。

root: 源自拉丁语 extremus（最靠外的），是 exterus（向外的）的最高级，核心义「刻度或范围的最远端」。

sensesIntro.en: Extreme means very great in degree, far from moderate, or the furthest point.
sensesIntro.cn: extreme 意为程度极大、远离温和，或最远的端点。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a gauge needle at the red end.
core.cn: 核心意象：仪表指针停在红色末端。

branches.en: The base sense is the far end of a scale.
branches.cn: 基础义是刻度的最远端。

branches.en: The far end becomes a judgment of views.
branches.cn: 最远端变成对观点的评判。

branches.en: The adjective becomes the endpoint itself.
branches.cn: 形容词变成端点本身。

branches.en: Great degree and immoderate views both sit at the edge.
branches.cn: 极大程度与偏激观点都位于边缘。

branches.en: Extreme views and extreme situations share the same edge.
branches.cn: 极端观点与极端处境共享同一条边缘。

intro.en: Extreme comes from the Latin exterus family and has a large modern word family.
intro.cn: extreme 来自拉丁语 exterus 词族，现代词族很大。

latinIntro.en: Latin extremus and exterus are the source forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 extremus 与 exterus 是来源形式。

items.meaning: the furthest end or a severe situation
items.example: The injury affected the lower extremity.

items.exampleCN: 政府反对暴力极端主义。

items.example: The group was led by an extremist.
items.exampleCN: 这个团体由一名极端分子领导。

items.meaning: the opposite ends of a range
items.exampleCN: 气候在两个极端之间摆动。
极限运动吸引勇敢的人。

latinEntries.example: Extra is related to the same family.

definition_en: to a very great degree; very; in an extreme way
core_image: 仪表指针一直冲到刻度尽头
scene: 这道题极其困难。The problem is extremely difficult.
sceneCN: 这里 extremely 是「极其、非常」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这道题极其困难。

senses.title: To a very great degree
senses.definition: to a very great degree
senses.definitionCN: 达到非常大的程度
senses.example: The water is extremely cold.
senses.exampleCN: 水非常冷。
senses.why: The core sense is reaching the far end of a scale.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是达到刻度的最远端。

senses.title: At the limit
senses.definition: at the furthest limit of what is possible
senses.definitionCN: 达到可能范围的极限
senses.example: The machine is extremely sensitive.
senses.exampleCN: 这台机器极其敏感。
senses.why: A high degree becomes a point near the limit.
senses.whyCN: 高程度变成接近极限的点。

senses.title: In an extreme way
senses.definition: in a way that goes far beyond what is moderate
senses.definitionCN: 以远远超出温和范围的方式
senses.example: He reacted extremely to the criticism.
senses.exampleCN: 他对批评反应过激。
senses.why: Manner joins degree at the edge of a scale.
senses.whyCN: 方式与程度在刻度边缘结合。

intro.en: Extremely is extreme plus the adverb ending -ly.
intro.cn: extremely 由 extreme 加副词词尾 -ly 构成。

items.en: Extremus means farthest out.
items.cn: extremus 意为最靠外的。

items.en: The Latin form marks the highest degree.
items.cn: 拉丁语形式标记最高程度。

items.en: Extreme describes the far end.
items.cn: extreme 描述最远端。

items.en: The ending -ly turns it into a way or degree.
items.cn: 词尾 -ly 把它变成方式或程度副词。

items.en: Extremely is a common intensifier.
items.cn: 现代英语中 extremely 是常用强调词。

note.en: Extremely means very; externally means from outside.
note.cn: extremely 是极其，externally 则是从外部。

normalIntro.en: Extremely pushes an adjective or adverb to the far end.
normalIntro.cn: extremely 把形容词或副词推到最远端。

normal.en: The exam was extremely difficult.
normal.cn: 考试极其困难。

normal.en: This species is extremely rare.
normal.cn: 这个物种极其罕见。

normal.en: She was extremely pleased with the result.
normal.cn: 她对结果非常满意。

normal.en: The road is extremely narrow here.
normal.cn: 这里的路极其狭窄。

normal.en: He spoke extremely quietly.
normal.cn: 他说话声音非常轻。

abstract.en: Picture a needle pressed against the final mark.
abstract.cn: 想象指针被压到最后一个刻度。

abstract.en: Imagine a volume knob turned all the way up.
abstract.cn: 想象音量旋钮被拧到最大。

abstract.en: Think of a rope pulled to its tightest.
abstract.cn: 想象绳子被拉到最紧。

examples.en: The instructions are extremely clear.
examples.cn: 说明极其清楚。

examples.en: It is extremely unlikely that he will come.
examples.cn: 他来的可能性极小。

examples.en: She was extremely careful with the glass.
examples.cn: 她对那只玻璃杯非常小心。

dict_mnemonic.text: extreme 加副词后缀 -ly，表示「达到极端程度」，就是 extremely。

root: 由 extreme 加 -ly 构成，根源是拉丁语 extremus（最靠外的），核心义「达到极端的程度」。

sensesIntro.en: Extremely means to a very great degree, at the limit, or in an extreme way.
sensesIntro.cn: extremely 意为程度极高、达到极限，或以极端方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a needle at the final mark.
core.cn: 核心意象：停在最后刻度上的指针。

branches.en: The base sense is a very high degree.
branches.cn: 基础义是极高的程度。

branches.en: High degree becomes a point near the limit.
branches.cn: 高程度变成接近极限的点。

branches.en: Manner joins degree at the edge of a scale.
branches.cn: 方式与程度在刻度边缘结合。

branches.en: Very great and near the limit describe the same intensity.
branches.cn: 极大与接近极限描述同一种强度。

branches.en: Degree and manner can both be extreme.
branches.cn: 程度与方式都可能是极端的。

intro.en: Extremely is extreme plus -ly, and it belongs to the Latin exterus family.
intro.cn: extremely 由 extreme 加 -ly 构成，属于拉丁语 exterus 词族。

latinIntro.en: Latin extremus and exterus lie behind the word.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 extremus 与 exterus 是该词的来源。

items.exampleCN: 这名极端分子拒绝一切妥协。

latinEntries.example: Extra belongs to the same family.

definition_en: the organ used for seeing; the ability to judge; a small hole or loop; to look at carefully
core_image: 一双明亮的眼睛，中间的瞳孔像深色的圆孔
scene: 她眼里含着泪水。There were tears in her eyes.
sceneCN: 这里 eye 是「眼睛」（第 1 个义项）；句意：她眼里含着泪水。

senses.title: The seeing organ
senses.definition: one of the two organs in the face used for seeing
senses.definitionCN: 脸上用于观看的两个器官之一
senses.example: She has bright blue eyes.
senses.exampleCN: 她有一双明亮的蓝眼睛。
senses.why: The core sense is the body part for sight.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是用于观看的身体器官。

senses.title: A good judgment
senses.definition: the ability to notice or judge things well
senses.definitionCN: 善于察觉或判断事物的能力
senses.example: He has an eye for detail.
senses.exampleCN: 他有发现细节的眼光。
senses.why: Seeing becomes the power to judge.
senses.whyCN: 看见变成判断的能力。

senses.title: A small hole
senses.definition: a small hole or loop shaped like an eye
senses.definitionCN: 形状像眼睛的小孔或环
senses.example: Thread the needle through its eye.
senses.exampleCN: 把线穿过针眼。
senses.why: The shape of the organ names similar objects.
senses.whyCN: 器官的形状被用来命名相似之物。

senses.title: To look at
senses.definition: to look at something carefully or with interest
senses.definitionCN: 仔细或饶有兴趣地看某物
senses.example: He eyed the cake hungrily.
senses.exampleCN: 他饥肠辘辘地盯着蛋糕。
senses.why: The organ of sight becomes the act of watching.
senses.whyCN: 观看的器官变成注视的动作。

intro.en: Eye comes from Old English ēage, from a Germanic root linked to seeing.
intro.cn: eye 源自古英语 ēage，来自与「看」有关的日耳曼语词根。

items.en: Eage names the organ of sight.
items.cn: eage 指观看的器官。

items.en: The root is linked to the act of seeing.
items.cn: 这个词根与「看」的动作有关。

items.en: Eage combines with other words for eyelids and brows.
items.cn: eage 与其他词组合成眼皮与眉毛等词。

items.en: Eye keeps the body sense and gains figurative uses.
items.cn: 中古英语中 eye 保留身体义并获得引申义。

items.en: Eye also means judgment and a small hole.
items.cn: 现代英语中 eye 也指眼光与小孔。

note.en: Eye is the organ; ewe is a female sheep.
note.cn: eye 是眼睛，ewe 则是母羊，两者读音相同。

entries.definition: having eyes of a stated kind
the ability to see or plan

normalIntro.en: Eye is the organ of sight and also the act of watching.
normalIntro.cn: eye 是观看的器官，也可指注视的动作。

normal.en: She closed her eyes and listened.
normal.cn: 她闭上眼睛倾听。

normal.en: Keep an eye on the children.
normal.cn: 照看好孩子们。

normal.en: The bright sign caught my eye.
normal.cn: 明亮的招牌吸引了我的注意。

normal.en: He has a good eye for color.
normal.cn: 他对色彩很有眼光。

normal.en: The needle's eye is very small.
normal.cn: 针眼非常小。

abstract.en: Picture two round windows looking onto the world.
abstract.cn: 想象两扇圆形的小窗望向世界。

abstract.en: Imagine a camera lens opening and closing.
abstract.cn: 想象相机镜头张开又合上。

abstract.en: Think of a pupil widening in dim light.
abstract.cn: 想象瞳孔在暗光中放大。

examples.en: He looked me straight in the eye.
examples.cn: 他直视我的眼睛。

examples.en: She has an eye for old furniture.
examples.cn: 她对旧家具有眼光。

examples.en: The cat eyed the bird from the window.
examples.cn: 猫从窗内盯着那只鸟。

dict_mnemonic.text: eye 的两个 e 像两只眼睛，中间的 y 像鼻子，一眼就记住「眼睛」。

root: 源自古英语 ēage，来自日耳曼语中与「看」有关的词根，核心义「观看的器官」及其引申。

sensesIntro.en: Eye means the organ of sight, good judgment, an eye-shaped hole, or to look at something.
sensesIntro.cn: eye 意为观看的器官、眼光、眼状小孔，或注视。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a bright pupil inside a round eye.
core.cn: 核心意象：圆眼睛里明亮的瞳孔。

branches.en: The base sense is the organ of sight.
branches.cn: 基础义是观看的器官。

branches.en: Seeing becomes the power to judge.
branches.cn: 看见变成判断的能力。

branches.en: The shape names similar small objects.
branches.cn: 形状被用来命名相似的小物件。

branches.en: The organ becomes the act of watching.
branches.cn: 器官变成注视的动作。

branches.en: The eye and the act of using it are closely linked.
branches.cn: 眼睛与使用眼睛的动作紧密相连。

intro.en: Eye is a native English word that forms many compounds, from eyelid to eyesight.
intro.cn: eye 是英语本族词，构成从 eyelid 到 eyesight 的许多复合词。

latinIntro.en: Eye has no Latin root; it comes from Old English eage.
latinIntro.cn: eye 没有拉丁词根，它来自古英语 eage。

items.meaning: organ of sight or to watch

items.exampleCN: 好视力在夜间很有帮助。

items.example: The empty building is an eyesore.

definition_en: the ability to see; the range within which you can see; the ability to judge
core_image: 远处字母表在眼前逐渐清晰或模糊
scene: 随着年龄增长，他的视力变差了。His eyesight grew worse with age.
sceneCN: 这里 eyesight 是「视力」（第 1 个义项）；句意：随着年龄增长，他的视力变差了。

senses.title: The ability to see
senses.definition: the ability of the eyes to see
senses.definitionCN: 眼睛观看的能力
senses.example: Good eyesight is important for driving.
senses.exampleCN: 好视力对开车很重要。
senses.why: The core sense is the power of the eyes.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是眼睛的观看能力。

senses.title: Range of vision
senses.definition: the distance within which things can be seen
senses.definitionCN: 能够看见事物的距离范围
senses.example: The plane disappeared from eyesight.
senses.exampleCN: 飞机从视野中消失了。
senses.why: The ability becomes the range it covers.
senses.whyCN: 能力变成它所覆盖的范围。

senses.title: Judgment
senses.definition: the ability to judge or notice things well
senses.definitionCN: 善于判断或察觉事物的能力
senses.example: His business eyesight is respected.
senses.exampleCN: 他的商业眼光受人尊敬。
senses.why: Physical sight becomes mental insight.
senses.whyCN: 身体上的视觉变成心智上的洞察。

intro.en: Eyesight joins eye and sight, two Old English words for seeing.
intro.cn: eyesight 由 eye 与 sight 组成，两者都是古英语中与「看」有关的词。

items.en: Eage names the organ of sight.
items.cn: eage 指观看的器官。

items.en: Sihth names the act or power of seeing.
items.cn: sihth 指看的动作或能力。

items.en: The two words join to name the power of the eyes.
items.cn: 两个词组合起来指眼睛的能力。

items.en: Eyesight becomes the common word for vision.
items.cn: 中古英语中 eyesight 成为表示视力的常用词。

items.en: Eyesight also covers range and judgment.
items.cn: 现代英语中 eyesight 也涵盖视野与眼光。

note.en: Eyesight is the power to see; insight is deep understanding.
note.cn: eyesight 是看的能力，insight 则是深刻的理解。

entries.definition: the power or act of seeing
what can be seen from a place

normalIntro.en: Eyesight is the power of the eyes to see clearly.
normalIntro.cn: eyesight 是眼睛清楚观看的能力。

normal.en: His eyesight is poor without glasses.
normal.cn: 不戴眼镜时他的视力很差。

normal.en: The test checks the eyesight of drivers.
normal.cn: 这项测试检查司机的视力。

normal.en: She lost her eyesight in one eye.
normal.cn: 她一只眼睛失明了。

normal.en: Good eyesight helped him spot the bird.
normal.cn: 好视力让他发现了那只鸟。

normal.en: Failing eyesight made reading difficult.
normal.cn: 视力衰退让阅读变得困难。

abstract.en: Picture letters on a chart fading into blur.
abstract.cn: 想象视力表上的字母渐渐变模糊。

abstract.en: Imagine a distant ship slowly leaving view.
abstract.cn: 想象远处的船慢慢离开视野。

abstract.en: Think of a sharp image coming into focus.
abstract.cn: 想象清晰的画面逐渐对焦。

examples.en: Regular tests can protect your eyesight.
examples.cn: 定期检查可以保护视力。

examples.en: His eyesight is still sharp at eighty.
examples.cn: 他八十岁视力仍然敏锐。

examples.en: The bird flew out of eyesight.
examples.cn: 鸟儿飞出了视野。

dict_mnemonic.text: eye（眼睛）加 sight（看），两者合起来就是眼睛看的能力，即 eyesight（视力）。

root: 由 eye 与 sight 复合而成，两者都源自古英语中与「看」有关的词，核心义「眼睛的观看能力」。

sensesIntro.en: Eyesight means the ability to see, the range of vision, or good judgment.
sensesIntro.cn: eyesight 意为观看能力、视野范围，或良好的判断力。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: letters coming into focus on a chart.
core.cn: 核心意象：视力表上的字母逐渐清晰。

branches.en: The base sense is the power to see.
branches.cn: 基础义是观看的能力。

branches.en: The ability becomes the range it covers.
branches.cn: 能力变成它所覆盖的范围。

branches.en: Physical sight becomes mental judgment.
branches.cn: 身体视觉变成心智判断。

branches.en: Clear sight and wide range support each other.
branches.cn: 清晰视力与宽广视野相互支持。

branches.en: Seeing well and judging well share the eye.
branches.cn: 看得清与判断准都离不开眼睛。

intro.en: Eyesight is a compound of two native English words about seeing.
intro.cn: eyesight 由两个表示「看」的英语本族词复合而成。

latinIntro.en: Eyesight has no Latin root; both parts are Old English.
latinIntro.cn: eyesight 没有拉丁词根，两个部分都来自古英语。

items.example: Sight is one of the five senses.
The center helps sighted and blind people.
items.exampleCN: 这个中心帮助视力正常者与盲人。

items.example: He is short-sighted in one eye.

items.meaning: unable to see near things clearly
items.example: She is long-sighted and needs glasses.

items.exampleCN: 头脑清醒的领导者会提前规划。

items.example: The book gives insight into history.
items.exampleCN: 这本书让人深入了解历史。

definition_en: cloth made by weaving or knitting; the structure of a society or system; the way parts are joined
core_image: 经纬线交错织成的一大块布
scene: 这种织物摸起来很柔软。This fabric feels very soft.
sceneCN: 这里 fabric 是「织物、布料」（第 1 个义项）；句意：这种织物摸起来很柔软。

senses.title: Woven cloth
senses.definition: cloth made by weaving or knitting threads
senses.definitionCN: 由纱线编织或针织成的布
senses.example: The curtains are made of cotton fabric.
senses.exampleCN: 窗帘是用棉布做的。
senses.why: The core sense is material made from joined threads.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是由线交织而成的材料。

senses.title: Structure
senses.definition: the way the parts of something are joined together
senses.definitionCN: 事物各部分连接在一起的方式
senses.example: The fabric of the building is still strong.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋建筑的结构仍然坚固。
senses.why: Joined threads become joined parts.
senses.whyCN: 交织的线变成连接的结构。

senses.title: The social system
senses.definition: the basic structure of a society or group
senses.definitionCN: 社会或群体的基本结构
senses.example: Trust holds the social fabric together.
senses.exampleCN: 信任维系着社会结构。
senses.why: A woven surface becomes the web of society.
senses.whyCN: 织成的表面变成社会之网。

intro.en: Fabric comes from Latin fabrica, a workshop or craft, from faber, a worker.
intro.cn: fabric 来自拉丁语 fabrica（作坊、技艺），根源是 faber（工匠）。

items.en: Faber means a worker or craftsman.
items.cn: faber 意为工匠。

items.en: Fabrica means a workshop or craft.
items.cn: fabrica 意为作坊或技艺。

items.en: Fabricare means to make or build.
items.cn: fabricare 意为制作或建造。

items.en: Fabric reaches English through French.
items.cn: fabric 经法语进入英语。

items.en: Fabric means cloth and also a structure.
items.cn: 现代英语中 fabric 既指布料也指结构。

note.en: Fabric is cloth or structure; fabricate is to make up.
note.cn: fabric 是织物或结构，fabricate 则是制造或捏造。

entries.definition: a thin thread used in cloth

normalIntro.en: Fabric is woven cloth and also the woven structure of a society.
normalIntro.cn: fabric 是织成的布，也指社会织成的结构。

normal.en: This fabric is soft and light.
normal.cn: 这种织物柔软轻便。

normal.en: The shop sells fabric by the meter.
normal.cn: 这家店按米卖布料。

normal.en: The old fabric of the city is changing.
normal.cn: 这座城市旧的结构正在改变。

normal.en: Poverty can damage the social fabric.
normal.cn: 贫困会损害社会结构。

normal.en: They chose a strong fabric for the curtains.
normal.cn: 他们为窗帘选了结实的布料。

abstract.en: Picture threads crossing over and under each other.
abstract.cn: 想象线一根根上下交错。

abstract.en: Imagine a city held together by many small ties.
abstract.cn: 想象城市被许多细小纽带连在一起。

abstract.en: Think of a net whose knots support the whole.
abstract.cn: 想象一张网，每个结都支撑整体。

examples.en: The dress is made from a light fabric.
examples.cn: 这条裙子用轻薄的布料做成。

examples.en: Trust is part of the fabric of a team.
examples.cn: 信任是团队结构的一部分。

examples.en: The fabric of the old house is still sound.
examples.cn: 老房子的结构仍然完好。

dict_mnemonic.text: fabric 与 fabricate 同源：先有「制作」，再指制作出的织物与结构。

root: 源自拉丁语 fabrica（作坊、技艺），由 faber（工匠）派生，核心义「制作出来的织物与结构」。

sensesIntro.en: Fabric means woven cloth, the way parts are joined, or the structure of a society.
sensesIntro.cn: fabric 意为织成的布、部件的连接方式，或社会结构。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: threads woven into one strong sheet.
core.cn: 核心意象：线交织成一整块结实的布。

branches.en: The base sense is woven cloth.
branches.cn: 基础义是织成的布。

branches.en: Joined threads become joined parts.
branches.cn: 交织的线变成连接的结构。

branches.en: A woven surface becomes the web of society.
branches.cn: 织成的表面变成社会之网。

branches.en: Cloth and building structure both depend on joining.
branches.cn: 布料与建筑结构都依赖连接。

branches.en: Material structure and social structure share a frame.
branches.cn: 物质结构与社会结构共享一个框架。

intro.en: Fabric belongs to the Latin faber family, like fabricate and fabrication.
intro.cn: fabric 属于拉丁语 faber 词族，与 fabricate、fabrication 同源。

latinIntro.en: Latin fabrica, fabricare, and faber are the source forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 fabrica、fabricare 与 faber 是来源形式。

items.meaning: the act of making or inventing
items.example: The story was a complete fabrication.
items.exampleCN: 这个故事完全是捏造的。

items.meaning: a person who makes or invents things
items.example: The fabricator cut the metal sheets.

items.exampleCN: 他们坐在覆有织物的椅子上。

latinEntries.example: Faber is the worker behind fabrica.
latinEntries.exampleCN: faber 是 fabrica 背后的工匠。

definition_en: the front of the head; the front surface of something; to turn toward something; to deal with a difficulty
core_image: 一张正对镜头的脸，背后是必须直面的墙
scene: 她面对困难从不退缩。She never backs away when she faces difficulty.
sceneCN: 这里 face 是「面对、面临」（第 3 个义项）；句意：她面对困难从不退缩。

senses.title: The front of the head
senses.definition: the front part of the head where the eyes, nose, and mouth are
senses.definitionCN: 头部前面长有眼睛、鼻子和嘴的部位
senses.example: She washed her face with cold water.
senses.exampleCN: 她用冷水洗脸。
senses.why: The core sense is the front of the head.
senses.whyCN: 核心义是头部的前面。

senses.title: The front surface
senses.definition: the front or outer surface of an object
senses.definitionCN: 物体的前面或外表面
senses.example: The face of the clock is cracked.
senses.exampleCN: 钟面裂了。
senses.why: The front of the head names the front of things.
senses.whyCN: 头部的前面被用来命名物体的正面。

senses.title: Turn toward
senses.definition: to turn or point toward someone or something
senses.definitionCN: 转向或朝向某人某物
senses.example: The house faces the sea.
senses.exampleCN: 这栋房子面朝大海。
senses.why: The front becomes the direction one turns.
senses.whyCN: 正面变成所朝的方向。

senses.title: Deal with difficulty
senses.definition: to have to deal with a difficult situation
senses.definitionCN: 不得不应对困难处境
senses.example: The company faces rising costs.
senses.exampleCN: 公司面临成本上升。
senses.why: Facing a person becomes facing a problem.
senses.whyCN: 面对一个人变成面对一个问题。

intro.en: Face comes from Latin facies, form or appearance, through Old French face.
intro.cn: face 经古法语 face 来自拉丁语 facies，意为形状或外观。

items.en: Facies means form, shape, or appearance.
items.cn: facies 意为形状、外形或外观。

items.en: The word covers both a face and a surface.
items.cn: 这个词兼指面孔与表面。

items.en: Face keeps the sense of front and look.
items.cn: 古法语 face 保留「正面与外观」之义。

items.en: Face becomes the common word for the front of the head.
items.cn: 中古英语中 face 成为表示面孔的常用词。

items.en: Face also means to confront a problem.
items.cn: 现代英语中 face 也指面对问题。

note.en: Face is the front; fact is something true.
note.cn: face 是正面，fact 则是事实。

normalIntro.en: Face moves from the front of the head to the front of things and to facing trouble.
normalIntro.cn: face 从头部正面扩展到物体正面，再到面对困难。

normal.en: She has a kind face.
normal.cn: 她有一张和善的脸。

normal.en: The north face of the mountain is cold.
normal.cn: 山的北面很冷。

normal.en: We sat face to face across the table.
normal.cn: 我们隔着桌子面对面坐着。

normal.en: The team faces a serious problem.
normal.cn: 团队面临一个严重问题。

normal.en: He made a face at the bitter medicine.
normal.cn: 他对着苦药做了个鬼脸。

abstract.en: Picture a face looking straight into a mirror.
abstract.cn: 想象一张正对镜子的脸。

abstract.en: Imagine a wall that stands against the wind.
abstract.cn: 想象一面迎着风的墙。

abstract.en: Think of a person stepping toward a hard task.
abstract.cn: 想象一个人迈向艰难任务。

examples.en: The building faces the main square.
examples.cn: 这栋建筑面向主广场。

examples.en: We must face the facts honestly.
examples.cn: 我们必须诚实面对事实。

examples.en: Her face showed no fear.
examples.cn: 她脸上没有露出恐惧。

dict_mnemonic.text: face 谐音「费事」：遇到麻烦要 face（面对），确实费事。

root: 源自拉丁语 facies（形状、外观），经古法语 face 进入英语，核心义「正面、面孔」及「正面对待」。

sensesIntro.en: Face means the front of the head, the front surface, to turn toward, or to deal with difficulty.
sensesIntro.cn: face 意为头部正面、物体表面、朝向，或面对困难。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a face turned straight toward the viewer.
core.cn: 核心意象：正对观看者的一张脸。

branches.en: The base sense is the front of the head.
branches.cn: 基础义是头部的前面。

branches.en: The head's front names the front of objects.
branches.cn: 头部正面被用来命名物体正面。

branches.en: The front becomes the direction one turns.
branches.cn: 正面变成所朝的方向。

branches.en: Facing a person becomes facing a problem.
branches.cn: 面对一个人变成面对一个问题。

branches.en: Turning toward a thing and confronting it share one motion.
branches.cn: 朝向某物与直面某物共享同一动作。

intro.en: Face comes from Latin facies and builds facial, facing, and faceless.
intro.cn: face 来自拉丁语 facies，并构成 facial、facing 与 faceless。

latinIntro.en: Latin facies and facere are related source forms.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 facies 与 facere 是相关的来源形式。

items.meaning: front of the head or to confront
more than one face or confronts
items.meaningCN: 面孔（复数）；面对（第三人称）

items.example: The room facing the sea is bright.
items.exampleCN: 面朝大海的房间很明亮。
看不清面孔的人群继续前行。
他们举行了面对面的会议。
